title: Enterprise Network Vulnerability Assessment Report
executive_summary: An automated network security assessment of target host 127.0.0.1 was conducted evaluating 103 TCP ports in Curated (103) mode. The assessment discovered 1 active listening service(s), with the maximum detected exposure reaching Medium severity and an overall risk score of 50/100 (Medium Risk). Identified services exhibited low-to-medium risk profiles with no direct high-severity CVE matches mapped in active service banners. Top Priority Remediation: Ensure valid SSL/TLS certificates; configure strong cipher suites; disable legacy SSLv3/TLS 1.0/1.1 protocols.

findings.remediation: Ensure valid SSL/TLS certificates; configure strong cipher suites; disable legacy SSLv3/TLS 1.0/1.1 protocols.
findings.title: Medium Exposure: nginx/1.18.0 on Port 443/TCP
findings.description: TCP port 443 was confirmed in the OPEN state via TCP SYN/connect handshake. Protocol probing extracted banner: "nginx/1.18.0". Identified software product: nginx version 1.18.0. No active public CVEs directly mapped in NIST NVD for this service banner.

disclaimer: Authorized testing only. Confidential security audit document.
